title: Payroll employee API with v1 and v2
name: Payroll employee API

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the v1 and v2 contracts are translated to and from the internal model? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A v2 client creates an employee with payFrequency "semimonthly". A v1 client then fetches the same employee. What payFrequency does the v1 client see?
Which response headers distinguish a GET /v1/employees/:id response from GET /v2/employees/:id?
choices: v1 responses carry Deprecation: true and a Link to /v2/employees with rel="successor-version"
v2 responses carry a Sunset header
Both carry Deprecation, but only v1 carries Link
Neither; the version is only in the path

questions.prompt: A v2 client posts compensation.annualSalaryCents as 7250000.5. What happens?
choices: It is rounded to 7250001 and stored
It is rejected with 422 because Number.isInteger fails
It is rejected with 500 because RangeError is unhandled
